B) Two short technical windows (both 20m) to accommodate travel: Thu 11/05 4:00 PM PT or Fri 11/06 9:00 AM PT — pick one and we'll book.

If you say C, I'll send the recording today; if A/B, I'll send a calendar invite immediately and include Ben's pre-read notes inline.
